item.title: Black Cat in Bathtub Print | Framed Wall Art That Comes With a Song
item.description: "Someone's in My Bath." A burgundy wall, an olive tiled floor and a white clawfoot tub in a slant of late sun. Inside the empty tub, a black cat sits with only its head above the rim, staring straight at you. Every print comes with a listening card: scan it and play the song we paired with the painting. Printed & shipped from the USA, framed or unframed. Original artwork by Atmosférico FM, created with AI-assisted tools.
